title: Yellow Springy Brazilian Shungiku Skewers
description: A crowd-pleasing Brazilian dish featuring shungiku, with a jammy and springy texture, perfect for any occasion. This kosher-friendly recipe is sure to delight your guests.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Thread the shungiku, yellow pepper, and garlic onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and ginger.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shungiku is tender and slightly charred.
Deglaze the grill with lime juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional lime juice and salt if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
